title: Hearty Smoky French Chicken Coq Au Vin
description: A mustardy and crisp French dish featuring melted butter and smoke-hot flavors, perfect for a festive occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the chicken thighs with smoked paprika and salt.
Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken thighs until browned on both sides, then set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter to the pot, then add the sliced onions and cook until caramelized.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the red wine, chicken broth, and Dijon mustard to the pot, stirring to combine.
Return the chicken thighs to the pot, cover, and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
